name: Mistral
billing: Studio documents a limited Free mode without a credit card. Check the organization’s plan and quotas; activate billing for paid usage.
steps: Create a Mistral account or sign in to Studio and select the intended organization and workspace.
Open API Keys in Studio, choose Create new key, and set its name, expiration and access scope.
Store the key on your own machine. Check your plan and usage limits before choosing a paid model.
